title: 第4617章 玄寂玄溟上人第4616章 你就是剑门唐天
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: “我已经走不了了。我的本源给了你朋友，我本身也快散了。留在这里陪着那东西，也算有始有终。”
那道身影轻轻摆了摆手，“去吧。你们活着，比什么都重要。”
黑影张了张嘴，最终什么也没说出来。
黑影沉默了很久，最后只是深深看了那道灰袍身影一眼，转身大步走开。
唐天没有多说，他知道有些告别不需要言语。
身后那道灰袍身影正在一点点变淡，像晨雾被阳光蒸干，无声无息，却再也抓不住。
“走吧。他撑不了多久了，再待下去也没有意义。”
唐天拍了拍黑影的肩膀，转身往舰队方向走去。
黑影脚步顿了一下，回头看了一眼那道已经透明到快要看不见的身影，然后头也不回地跟上了唐天。
回到舰队的时候，胖子小风正蹲在主控舰的舰首上嗑瓜子，看到唐天回来立马跳了下来：“大哥，里面那是什么情况？”
“回去再说。”
唐天登舰，目光扫过众人，“撤，离开这片星域。”
舰队调转方向，迅速撤离这片暗紫色的雾海。
那道裂缝在他们身后缓缓闭合，暗紫色雾气重新合拢，将一切痕迹掩埋。
返程的路上，唐天把事情的经过简单讲了一遍。
黑影也说了自己的名字，叫“玄寂”。
那道灰袍身影是他师尊，叫“玄溟上人”，是混沌海早期为数不多的道神境巅峰强者之一。
当年为了镇压裂缝里的东西，玄溟上人以身入阵，把自己和那东西一起困在了裂缝深处，一困就是无尽岁月。
“也就是说，你师尊的本源现在渡给了老大，老大接下来要代替你师尊镇守那道裂缝？”
云皓听完，神色变得凝重起来。
“三年。”
唐天靠在舱壁上，“三年之内我得想办法把裂缝里的东西彻底解决掉，不然三年之后裂缝崩溃，那东西照样会出来。”
“有把握吗？”
冥花问得很直接。
“没有。但总得试试。”
唐天回答得也干脆，“玄溟上人说过，那东西会吞噬法则，我身上的混沌本源对它来说就是最好的食物。所以硬碰硬肯定不行，得想别的办法。”
“什么办法？”
胖子小风凑过来，瞪着一双大眼珠子。
“你师尊当年，有没有留下什么关于那个东西的记载？哪怕只言片语都行。”
唐天没有回答，而是转头看向玄寂。
“师尊当年留下过一些手记，但大部分都在漫长的岁月里被毁掉了。这枚玉简是他被困之前留下的，里面记载了他对那东西的一些观察。”
玄寂想了想，从袖中取出一枚残破的玉简。
唐天接过玉简，神念探入。
里面的内容不多，大多是一些零散的记录，像是匆忙间写下的。
但其中有一段话引起了他的注意：“它虽吞噬法则，却排斥纯粹的肉身之力。凡血肉之躯触及，皆会被其本能排斥。”
“肉身之力？”
唐天眉头微微一挑。
他的混元太初体，本身就已经修炼到了极高的境界。
再加上这些年无数次淬炼，肉身强度远超同阶。
如果那东西真的排斥纯粹的肉身之力，那对他来说反而是一条可以利用的路径。
“还有别的吗？”
唐天看向玄寂。
content_en:
"I can't leave anymore. My origin has been given to your friend, and I am about to leave. Staying here with that thing can be considered a beginning and an end."
The figure waved his hand gently, "Go ahead. Your survival is more important than anything else."
The black shadow opened his mouth, but finally said nothing.
The black shadow was silent for a long time, and finally just took a deep look at the gray-robed figure, turned around and strode away.
Tang Tian didn't say much, he knew that some farewells don't require words.
The gray-robed figure behind him is fading little by little, like morning mist being evaporated by the sun, soundless, but can no longer be grasped.
"Let's go. He can't last much longer, and there's no point in staying any longer."
Tang Tian patted the black shadow on the shoulder, turned around and walked towards the fleet.
The black shadow paused for a moment, looked back at the figure that was so transparent that it was almost invisible, and then followed Tang Tian without looking back.
When they returned to the fleet, Fatty Xiaofeng was squatting on the bow of the main control ship, eating melon seeds. When he saw Tang Tian coming back, he jumped down immediately: "Brother, what's going on inside?"
"Let's talk about it when we get back."
Tang Tian boarded the ship and glanced at everyone, "Retreat, leave this star field."
The fleet turned around and quickly evacuated this dark purple sea of fog.
The crack slowly closed behind them, and the dark purple mist closed again, burying all traces.
On the way back, Tang Tian briefly told what happened.
The black shadow also said his name, "Xuanji".
That gray-robed figure was his master, called "Master Xuanming". He was one of the few peak Taoist realm experts in the early days of the Sea of ​​Chaos.
In order to suppress the things in the cracks, Master Xuanming threw himself into the battle and trapped himself and the things deep in the cracks for endless years.
"In other words, your master's origin is now transferred to the boss, and the boss will guard the crack in your master's place next?"
After hearing this, Yun Hao's expression became solemn.
"Three years."
Tang Tian leaned against the bulkhead, "I have to find a way to completely remove the things in the cracks within three years, otherwise the cracks will collapse in three years and the things will still come out."
"Are you sure?"
Minghua asked very directly.
"No. But gotta try."
Tang Tian answered simply, "Master Xuanming said that that thing will swallow the law, and the source of chaos in me is the best food for it. So head-on confrontation will definitely not work, you have to find other ways."
"What can I do?"
Fatty Xiaofeng came over and stared with his big eyes.
"Did your master leave any records about that thing back then? Even just a few words will do."
Tang Tian did not answer, but turned to look at Xuan Ji.
"Master left some notes back then, but most of them were destroyed over the long years. This jade slip was left before he was trapped, and it contains some of his observations about that thing."
Xuanji thought for a while and took out a broken jade slip from his sleeve.
Tang Tian took the jade slip and penetrated it with his spiritual thoughts.
There is not much content in it, mostly scattered records, as if written in a hurry.
But one of the passages caught his attention: "Although it swallows the law, it rejects the power of pure flesh. Any flesh and blood that touches it will be rejected by its instinct."
"Physical power?"
Tang Tian raised his eyebrows slightly.
His Hunyuan Taichu Body has already reached an extremely high level.
Coupled with countless temperings over the years, the strength of the physical body far exceeds that of the same level.
If that thing really rejects pure physical power, then it is a path that he can use.
"Is there anything else?"
Tang Tian looked at Xuan Ji.
title_en: Chapter 4617 Master Xuanji Xuanming Chapter 4616 You are Tang Tian of the Sword Sect
